en-GB.title: Creative Financing II: Lease Options and Subject-To Deals
en-GB.summary: Creative Financing II: Lease Options and Subject-To Deals
en-GB.body: A lease option gives a tenant the right, but not the obligation, to buy later under agreed terms. A subject-to purchase transfers ownership while the seller's existing mortgage remains in the seller's name, creating significant legal and lender risk, including possible due-on-sale enforcement. These structures allocate ownership, financing responsibility, timing and risk differently. They are not shortcuts around due diligence and require careful jurisdiction-specific legal review before use.
